artifacts.summary: Cycle-2 reshape to the captain's lean ruling. Centerpiece verified at source: .goreleaser.yaml line 105 makes any hyphen-free tag a full release and line 125's skip_upload:auto skips only prereleases, so an old-line cut moves /releases/latest AND the stable brew cask DOWN with all jobs green — the new e2e-gate step blocks that before goreleaser starts. Fresh six-test spike on the gate's own read path, including the review-demanded fixture shape (version inversion WITHOUT ancestry inversion: a 0.27.1-stamped CHILD of the 0.28.0 commit fast-forwards cleanly, so only the decision gate can refuse it). Lease/force machinery dropped with its findings; deferral pointer to patch-line-stable-delivery-merge-commit (mex) recorded with the merge-commit direction and the re-verified no-branch-protection fact. Two honest divergences: estimate +355/11 files, NOT under half — both the dropped and added mechanisms are dominated by the same replay harness; the lean saving is authority and risk, not lines, and a -74 menu is named. And the gate passes a legitimate same-line patch cut by construction, which still freezes the channel on the next latest-line cut — the do-not-cut-a-patch-line operational constraint stays until the follow-up ships.
